mechanism: Both agents can cause hypotension and hyperkalemia; sitagliptin may enhance the hypoglycemic effect of captopril in diabetic patients, and captopril reduces glomerular filtration potentially increasing sitagliptin levels.
action: Monitor blood pressure, potassium levels, and renal function regularly; adjust sitagliptin dosing if eGFR <50 mL/min; counsel patient on hypoglycemia symptoms.
